name: Mistress of Runes

related.relation: her jarl, who did not listen

facts.text: The Mistress of Runes is a level-63 named with 30,000 health in Dodens Gruva.
She casts flaming spears from above (Odin's Hatred, 650 damage in a 450 radius) and Mistress's Vision, a nearsight on a far target.
Allakhazam lists her at 55-60; she drops a staff of runes and icy sapphire jewels for all three realms.

story:
The Mistress of Runes cut the marks that told the mine where to go. A good runecarver can read a mountain: the runes, cut in the right places, tell her where the ore runs and the rock is sound and the water lies. She read this mountain better than anyone, and for years the mine went where she said and prospered. Then she read the last seam, and the runes said not here, and she told the jarl. He laughed. She told him again, in front of the huscarls, which a jarl's runecarver does not do. He dug anyway.

When the seam opened and the voices came, she was the one who understood them first. She heard three tongues, and she knew one of them from the runes of the oldest stones, the ones nobody cuts any more. She did not go down. She went to the gallery where her runes ran out, the last place in the mine she had marked, and she cut one more, deeper than all the others: not here. Then she stood in front of it, and she has stood there since.

She throws the spears of Odin's Hatred down on anyone who passes, magical flaming spears that fall from above and burn a whole circle of the gallery. She casts a curse of vision that dims the eyes of whoever looks at her too long, so that they cannot see what is in front of them, as the jarl could not. She is not bound to the mine as the others are, the miners say. She stays because she warned him, and someone has to keep warning.
legend: Spread out: her flaming spears land in a circle and hurt. Her nearsight hits from a long way off, so casters fight from inside it or get purged. One group can manage her if they don't clump. Her sapphire jewels drop for every realm, which nobody can explain; the staff of runes is the runemasters' prize. Kill her quickly; the spears come often. Old raiders called her the warning. Her spears fall where the group stands, so keep moving in small steps. Runemasters like to say she is the only one in the mine who was right, and they hit her a little more gently.

loremasterTopic.text: The runecarver who read the mountain for Jarl [Ormarr] and warned him off the cold seam. He dug anyway. The last rune she carved says only: not here.

bookPage: From the notebook of a runemaster of Jordheim who went down to the gallery and copied the Mistress's last runes. The marks are the ordinary marks of a mine runecarver: ore, water, sound rock, danger. Then they stop, and one is cut very deep, in letters older than any I know, and it means not here. Beneath it, in her own ordinary hand, she has cut the reason. It took me a long time to read it. It says: because they are calling, and if we answer, we will be theirs. I copied it twice and burned both copies.
